Mcu.h
⌋

clock to the MCU clock distribution.⌋

rent clock source (for example internal oscillator clock) from MCU clock distribution.⌋

further action.⌋()
[SWS_Mcu_00205]: ⌈The function Mcu_DistributePllClock shall be
available if the pre-compile parameter McuNoPll is set to FALSE.
Otherwise, this Api has to be disabled (see also [ECUC_Mcu_00180]).⌋()
